name: Mattermost
description: Mattermost team chat from any AI agent, self-hosted or Cloud: teams, channels, messages and threads, message and file search, users, pinned posts, reactions and file descriptions. Sends messages, replies in threads, edits posts and reacts in the name of a bot or user account; deleting is switched off.
instructions:
## Mattermost
This connector calls the **Mattermost REST API v4** of one Mattermost server, self-hosted or Mattermost Cloud: teams, channels, messages and threads, search, users, reactions and the description of attached files. It reads what its account can read and posts in that account's name.

**Setup (about 5 minutes)**
1. `MATTERMOST_URL`: the address you open Mattermost at, without a trailing slash and without `/api/v4`, e.g. `https://chat.example.com` or `https://yourcompany.cloud.mattermost.com`.
2. Choose the account the connector acts as:
   - **Bot account** (recommended for a shared assistant): a system admin opens **System Console, Integrations, Bot Accounts** (enable bot account creation there first), then **Integrations, Bot Accounts, Add Bot Account** in a team's menu, and copies the token shown once. Add the bot to every team and channel it should read or post in.
   - **Personal access token** (acts as you): a system admin enables **System Console, Integrations, Integration Management, Enable Personal Access Tokens** and allows them for your user (System Console, Users, your user, Manage Roles). Then open **Profile, Security, Personal Access Tokens, Create Token** and copy the **Access Token** (not the Token ID); it is shown once.
3. Paste the token into `MATTERMOST_TOKEN`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and does not expire unless the server sets an expiry or it is revoked.

**Where Mattermost runs**
- **Self-hosted AnythingMCP**: a Mattermost server on a private network (`http://10.0.0.5:8065`, an internal host name) is blocked by the outbound SSRF guard by default; an administrator must allow the host through the `SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS` environment variable or the allowlist in the admin settings.
- **AnythingMCP Cloud**: Cloud can only reach a server that is public over HTTPS. A private address is refused.

**Where to start**
- `mattermost_get_me` for the account's own id, then `mattermost_list_my_teams` for team ids and `mattermost_list_my_channels` for the channels of a team (public, private, direct and group messages).
- Read: `mattermost_list_channel_posts`, `mattermost_get_thread`, `mattermost_get_post`, `mattermost_list_pinned_posts`. Search: `mattermost_search_posts` and `mattermost_search_files`.
- Find a channel: `mattermost_search_channels`, `mattermost_get_channel_by_name`, `mattermost_list_public_channels`; details with `mattermost_get_channel`, `mattermost_get_channel_stats` and `mattermost_list_channel_members`.
- People: `mattermost_search_users`, `mattermost_get_user`, `mattermost_get_user_by_username`, `mattermost_list_users`, `mattermost_list_team_members`. Teams: `mattermost_list_teams`, `mattermost_get_team`, `mattermost_get_team_by_name`.
- Threads the account follows: `mattermost_list_followed_threads`. Reactions: `mattermost_list_post_reactions`. Files: `mattermost_list_post_files` and `mattermost_get_file_info` (descriptions only, never the content).

**Writing**
- `mattermost_create_post` sends a message at once; with `root_id` it replies in a thread. For a direct message call `mattermost_create_direct_channel` first and post to the channel id it returns. Say where the message goes and what it says before sending, unless the user already dictated both.
- `mattermost_update_post` edits a post or pins it. `mattermost_add_reaction` adds an emoji reaction.
- Switched off at install: `mattermost_delete_post` and `mattermost_remove_reaction`. Channels, teams and users cannot be created, changed or removed through this connector, and files cannot be uploaded.

**Reading the data**
- Ids are 26 lower-case letters and digits. Posts carry `user_id` and `channel_id`, not names: resolve them with `mattermost_get_user` and `mattermost_get_channel`.
- Post lists come as `order` (ids, newest first) and `posts` (a map from id to post). A post with a `root_id` is a reply; its thread is `mattermost_get_thread` with any id of the thread.
- Times are Unix epoch **milliseconds** in UTC. `delete_at` 0 means not deleted.
- Channel `type`: O public, P private, D direct message, G group message. The `name` of a team or channel is the handle in its URL; `display_name` is what people see.
- The account only sees channels it is a member of (plus public channels of its teams). A 403 on a channel usually means the bot or user has not been added to it.

**Limits and errors**: lists return 60 items per page (at most 200); pages start at 0. A server with rate limiting on answers 429 and sends `X-Ratelimit-Reset` (seconds to wait); the default is 10 requests per second. 401: the token is wrong or revoked, or personal access tokens were switched off. 403: the account lacks the permission. 404: the id does not exist, or `MATTERMOST_URL` is wrong or already ends in `/api/v4`. Search needs at least one term and finds only what the account may read.
prerequisites: A Mattermost server (self-hosted or Mattermost Cloud) reachable from AnythingMCP (on Cloud: public over HTTPS) and a bot account token or a personal access token. A system admin must have enabled bot accounts or personal access tokens. About 5 minutes.

MATTERMOST_URL.label: Mattermost URL
MATTERMOST_URL.help: The address you open Mattermost at, without a trailing slash and without /api/v4. On AnythingMCP Cloud it must be public over HTTPS.
MATTERMOST_URL.patternMessage: Enter the full address starting with https:// or http://, without a trailing slash, e.g. https://chat.example.com.

MATTERMOST_TOKEN.label: Access token
MATTERMOST_TOKEN.help: The token of a bot account (Integrations, Bot Accounts) or a personal access token (Profile, Security, Personal Access Tokens, Create Token). Copy the Access Token, not the Token ID; it is shown once.
MATTERMOST_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the access token (26 letters and digits), without Bearer in front. The Token ID shown next to it is not the token.

verifyHints.401: Mattermost refused the token: it is wrong or revoked, the Token ID was pasted instead of the Access Token, or personal access tokens were switched off on the server.
verifyHints.403: Mattermost accepted the token but this account may not do that. Add the bot or user to the team and channel, or ask a system admin for the permission.
verifyHints.404: Nothing answered at this address or the id does not exist. Check MATTERMOST_URL: the address you open Mattermost at, without /api/v4 and without a trailing slash.
verifyHints.rate_limited: The Mattermost server is rate-limiting this account. Wait the seconds given in X-Ratelimit-Reset and try again.
verifyHints.unreachable: The Mattermost server cannot be reached. Check MATTERMOST_URL; a server on a private network must be allowed in the SSRF allowlist (self-hosted) or be public over HTTPS (Cloud).

tools.name: mattermost_get_me
tools.description: Get the account this connector acts as (the owner of the token or the bot): id, username, email, first_name, last_name, nickname, roles, locale and timezone. The id is needed for reactions and direct messages, and posts are written in this account's name.

tools.name: mattermost_list_users
tools.description: List users, optionally only the members of one team or channel. Each user has id, username, first_name, last_name, nickname, email (when visible to this account), position, roles and delete_at (non-zero for a deactivated account). Pages with page and per_page.

in_team.description: Only members of this team (team id).

in_channel.description: Only members of this channel (channel id).

sort.description: Sort order, only together with in_team: last_activity_at or create_at. Default by username.

per_page.description: Items per page, at most 200. Default 60.

tools.name: mattermost_search_users
tools.description: Find users by a term matched against username, full name, nickname and email. Returns the matching users with id, username, first_name, last_name, nickname, email and position. Use it to turn a name into a user id.

term.description: Text to look for, e.g. a first name, a username or an email address.

team_id.description: Only users of this team (team id).

in_channel_id.description: Only members of this channel (channel id).

allow_inactive.description: true to include deactivated accounts. Default false.

tools.name: mattermost_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by id: username, first_name, last_name, nickname, email (when visible), position, roles, locale, timezone and delete_at. Use it to turn the user_id of a post into a name.

user_id.description: User id (26 characters) from mattermost_search_users or mattermost_list_users.

tools.name: mattermost_get_user_by_username
tools.description: Get one user by username (the handle after the @ sign, without the @): id, first_name, last_name, nickname, email (when visible), position and roles.

username.description: Username without the @ sign, e.g. anna.rossi.

tools.name: mattermost_list_my_teams
tools.description: List the teams this account belongs to: id, name (the URL handle), display_name, description, type (O for open, I for invite only) and delete_at. Start here: channels and searches need a team id.

tools.name: mattermost_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams of the server that this account may see: its own teams plus teams open to join (all teams for a system admin). Each team has id, name, display_name, description and type. Pages with page and per_page.

per_page.description: Items per page, at most 200. Default 60.

tools.name: mattermost_get_team
tools.description: Get one team by id: name, display_name, description, type, company_name, allowed_domains, allow_open_invite, create_at and delete_at.

tools.name: mattermost_get_team_by_name
tools.description: Get one team by its name, the handle in the team URL (for https://chat.example.com/engineering/channels/town-square the name is engineering): id, display_name, description and type.

team_name.description: Team name as it appears in the URL, lower case, e.g. engineering.

tools.name: mattermost_list_team_members
tools.description: List the members of a team: user_id, roles, scheme_admin (team admin), scheme_guest and delete_at per member. Names are not included: resolve user ids with mattermost_get_user. Pages with page and per_page.

per_page.description: Items per page, at most 200. Default 60.

tools.name: mattermost_list_my_channels
tools.description: List every channel of one team that this account is a member of, including private channels, direct messages (type D) and group messages (type G). Each channel has id, name, display_name, type (O public, P private, D direct, G group), header, purpose, last_post_at and total_msg_count.

tools.name: mattermost_list_public_channels
tools.description: List the public channels of a team, whether or not this account has joined them: id, name, display_name, header, purpose and last_post_at. Pages with page and per_page.

per_page.description: Items per page, at most 200. Default 60.

tools.name: mattermost_search_channels
tools.description: Find channels of a team by a term matched against the channel name, display name and purpose. Returns public channels and the private channels this account belongs to, each with id, name, display_name and type.

term.description: Text to look for in channel names, e.g. marketing.

tools.name: mattermost_get_channel
tools.description: Get one channel by id: team_id, name, display_name, type, header, purpose, creator_id, create_at, last_post_at and total_msg_count.

channel_id.description: Channel id (26 characters) from mattermost_list_my_channels or mattermost_search_channels.

tools.name: mattermost_get_channel_by_name
tools.description: Get one channel by its name, the handle in the channel URL (for https://chat.example.com/engineering/channels/release-notes the name is release-notes), inside a team: id, display_name, type, header and purpose.

channel_name.description: Channel name as it appears in the URL, lower case with hyphens, e.g. town-square.

tools.name: mattermost_list_channel_members
tools.description: List the members of a channel: user_id, roles, last_viewed_at, msg_count and mention_count per member. Names are not included: resolve user ids with mattermost_get_user. Pages with page and per_page.

channel_id.description: Channel id (26 characters) from mattermost_list_my_channels or mattermost_search_channels.

per_page.description: Items per page, at most 200. Default 60.

tools.name: mattermost_get_channel_stats
tools.description: Get the size of a channel: member_count, guest_count, pinnedpost_count and files_count.

channel_id.description: Channel id (26 characters) from mattermost_list_my_channels or mattermost_search_channels.

tools.name: mattermost_create_direct_channel
tools.description: Open the direct message channel between two users (it is created when it does not exist yet) and return it with its id. To send someone a direct message: pass your own id from mattermost_get_me and the other user's id, then call mattermost_create_post with the returned channel id.

user_id.description: Your own user id, from mattermost_get_me.

other_user_id.description: User id of the other person, from mattermost_search_users.

tools.name: mattermost_list_channel_posts
tools.description: Read the messages of a channel, newest first. Returns order (post ids, newest first) and posts (a map from id to post with id, user_id, message, create_at, update_at, root_id for replies, reply_count, file_ids, is_pinned and props), plus next_post_id and prev_post_id. Page with page and per_page, or pass since to get everything changed after a moment. Times such as create_at and update_at are Unix epoch milliseconds.

channel_id.description: Channel id (26 characters) from mattermost_list_my_channels or mattermost_search_channels.

per_page.description: Items per page, at most 200. Default 60.

since.description: Only posts created or changed after this time, Unix epoch milliseconds, e.g. 1763510400000. Do not combine with page, per_page, before or after; at most 1000 posts come back.

before.description: Only posts older than this post id.

after.description: Only posts newer than this post id.

tools.name: mattermost_get_post
tools.description: Get one post by id: channel_id, user_id, message, create_at, update_at, edit_at, root_id (set when it is a reply), reply_count, file_ids, is_pinned, props and metadata with files, reactions and embeds. Times such as create_at and update_at are Unix epoch milliseconds.

post_id.description: Post id (26 characters) from a post list or search.

tools.name: mattermost_get_thread
tools.description: Get a whole thread: the root post and every reply. Works with the id of any post in the thread. Returns order (post ids) and posts (a map from id to post), as mattermost_list_channel_posts does.

post_id.description: Post id (26 characters) from a post list or search.

per_page.description: Posts per page for a long thread. Leave out for the whole thread.

from_post.description: Post id to continue from on the next page.

tools.name: mattermost_list_pinned_posts
tools.description: List the posts pinned in a channel, as order and posts like mattermost_list_channel_posts. Pinned posts usually hold the rules, links and decisions of a channel.

channel_id.description: Channel id (26 characters) from mattermost_list_my_channels or mattermost_search_channels.

tools.name: mattermost_search_posts
tools.description: Search the messages of one team that this account can read. Returns order, posts (a map from id to post) and matches. The terms accept Mattermost search modifiers: from:username, in:channel-name, before:2026-11-01, after:2026-10-01, on:2026-10-15, quoted phrases and a minus sign in front of a word to exclude it.

terms.description: Search terms, e.g. deployment failed in:devops after:2026-11-01.

is_or_search.description: true to match any of the words, false to match all of them. Default false.

time_zone_offset.description: Offset of the user's time zone from UTC in seconds, for the date modifiers, e.g. 3600 for UTC+1. Default 0.

include_deleted_channels.description: true to search archived channels too. Default false.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0. Only servers with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch page the results.

per_page.description: Posts per page. Only servers with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch page the results.

tools.name: mattermost_create_post
tools.description: Send a message to a channel, or reply in a thread when root_id is given. The message is posted at once in the name of the connector's account and everyone in the channel sees it. Markdown is supported; mention people with @username. Returns the new post with its id.

channel_id.description: Id of the channel to post in (26 characters). For a direct message use the id from mattermost_create_direct_channel.

message.description: Text of the message, Markdown allowed. At most 16383 characters.

root_id.description: Id of the first post of a thread, to reply in that thread. Leave out for a new message.

file_ids.description: Ids of files already uploaded to Mattermost to attach, at most 5.

tools.name: mattermost_update_post
tools.description: Edit the text of an existing post or pin and unpin it. Only the fields given are changed. Editing another person's post needs the matching permission; Mattermost marks the post as edited.

post_id.description: Post id (26 characters) from a post list or search.

message.description: New text of the post, Markdown allowed.

is_pinned.description: true to pin the post to its channel, false to unpin it.

tools.name: mattermost_delete_post
tools.description: Delete a post. Installed switched off: the message disappears for everyone, and deleting the first post of a thread removes its replies from view as well. It cannot be restored through the API.

post_id.description: Post id (26 characters) from a post list or search.

tools.name: mattermost_list_followed_threads
tools.description: List the threads this account follows in a team (needs collapsed reply threads on the server). Returns total, total_unread_threads, total_unread_mentions and threads, each with id (the root post id), reply_count, last_reply_at, unread_replies, unread_mentions, participants and the root post.

since.description: Only threads updated after this time, Unix epoch milliseconds.

extended.description: true to include the participants' user details.

per_page.description: Items per page, at most 200. Default 60.

tools.name: mattermost_list_post_reactions
tools.description: List the emoji reactions on a post: user_id, emoji_name and create_at per reaction. An empty answer means nobody reacted.

post_id.description: Post id (26 characters) from a post list or search.

tools.name: mattermost_add_reaction
tools.description: React to a post with an emoji in the name of the connector's account, for example to acknowledge a request. Returns the reaction. A reaction can only be added for the account the token belongs to.

user_id.description: Your own user id, from mattermost_get_me. Mattermost refuses any other user.

post_id.description: Post id (26 characters) from a post list or search.

emoji_name.description: Emoji name without colons, e.g. thumbsup, white_check_mark or eyes.

tools.name: mattermost_remove_reaction
tools.description: Remove one of this account's own emoji reactions from a post. Installed switched off like every delete.

post_id.description: Post id (26 characters) from a post list or search.

emoji_name.description: Emoji name without colons, as mattermost_list_post_reactions returns it.

tools.name: mattermost_list_post_files
tools.description: List the files attached to a post: id, name, extension, size in bytes, mime_type, create_at and, for images, width and height. Only the description of the files is returned, not their content.

post_id.description: Post id (26 characters) from a post list or search.

tools.name: mattermost_get_file_info
tools.description: Get the description of one uploaded file: name, extension, size in bytes, mime_type, the post and channel it belongs to, the uploader (creator_id) and create_at. The content of the file is not returned.

file_id.description: File id (26 characters) from file_ids of a post or from mattermost_list_post_files.

tools.name: mattermost_search_files
tools.description: Search the files shared in one team by file name, extension and, when the server extracts it, file content. Returns order and file_infos (a map from id to file with name, extension, size, mime_type, channel_id, post_id and create_at). The terms accept from:username, in:channel-name and ext:pdf.

terms.description: Search terms, e.g. budget ext:xlsx in:finance.

is_or_search.description: true to match any of the words, false to match all of them. Default false.

include_deleted_channels.description: true to search archived channels too. Default false.
